title: How to Build a Social App With AI (Profiles, Feeds, and Follows — No Code)
summary: Build a niche social app with user profiles, a post feed, follows, likes, and comments. The complete guide to building and launching a social platform without writing code.
body_markdown: Blink's hosting auto-scales. A social app for a niche community (a few thousand users, moderate posting activity) runs without any infrastructure work on your part. The main scaling consideration is image storage — high-volume photo posting at scale needs CDN caching. Ask: "Set up image CDN caching for profile photos and post images." Blink configures the CDN automatically.
